'''Volume 4''' is the fourth and final omnibus volume of the {{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga created by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and [[Satoshi Yamamoto]]. It was published by [[Shogakukan Asia]] in {{pmin|Singapore}}, although it uses [[VIZ Media]]'s translation. This volume contains all the chapters originally found in {{PAV|21}} and {{PAV|22}} (excluding [[PS268]] and [[PS269]], which are part of the {{MangaArc|FireRed & LeafGreen}}).

==Major events==
{{spoilers}}
* [[Wallace]] becomes the champion of the [[Elite Four]].
* The [[Red Orb]] and the [[Blue Orb]] are forced out of [[Maxie]] and [[Archie]].
* {{Steven}} awakens the [[legendary giants]].
* {{adv|Ruby}} and {{adv|Sapphire}} go to {{gdis|Mirage Island|III}}.
* Ruby realizes that he and Sapphire have the Red and Blue Orbs inside them.
* Sapphire defeats [[Tate and Liza|Tate, Liza]], and [[Juan]].
* Ruby and Sapphire leave Mirage Island.
* {{adv|Wally}} awakens {{p|Rayquaza}}, and [[Norman]] heads with it to [[Sootopolis City]].
* Ruby reveals he was the boy Sapphire met five years ago.
* [[Courtney]] dies from being buried under a rockslide after being dragged into the [[Cave of Origin]].
* [[Norman]] and {{Steven}} meet the same fate after quelling the giants due to the strain of controlling the powerful legends.
* The reasons for Norman's banning from taking the Gym Leader test are revealed, as are many details regarding {{adv|Ruby}}'s past history with him.
* [[Maxie]] and [[Archie]] return and, after badly wounding [[Wallace]] by taking [[Winona]] hostage, are eventually defeated by the combined efforts of Ruby and {{adv|Sapphire}}.
* {{adv|Celebi}} is able to take back the [[Red Orb|Red]] and [[Blue Orb]]s and use its [[time travel]] powers to alter the course of events, reviving Courtney, Steven, and Norman.
* Both Ruby and Sapphire are able to meet the deadline on their respective challenges and return to [[Littleroot Town]], where Ruby's delayed birthday party is celebrated together with Sapphire's birthday.

* Ruby's {{p|Feebas}} "[[Feefee]]" evolves into {{p|Milotic}} in [[PS266]].

===Other===

==Gym battles==
* Sapphire defeats [[Tate and Liza]] together with Ruby in [[PS257]].
* Sapphire defeats [[Juan]] in PS257.
* Sapphire defeats [[Norman]] in [[PS267]].

==Pokémon Contests==
* Ruby wins Master Rank Pokémon Contests in all categories in [[PS267]].
